description: There are two processes, process A and process B, to plate a coin with gold. Process A requires 3 units of gold, 2 wires, and can plate 5 coins. Process B requires 5 units of gold, 3 wires, and can plate 7 coins. There are 500 units of gold and 300 wires available. How many processes of each type should be run to maximize the total number of coins that can be plated?

GoldRequiredProcessA.definition: Amount of gold required to run Process A once

WireRequiredProcessA.definition: Number of wires required to run Process A once

CoinsPlatedProcessA.definition: Number of coins plated per execution of Process A

GoldRequiredProcessB.definition: Amount of gold required to run Process B once

WireRequiredProcessB.definition: Number of wires required to run Process B once

CoinsPlatedProcessB.definition: Number of coins plated per execution of Process B

objective.description: "Maximize the total number of coins plated by running Process A and Process B"

constraints.description: 2 * (number of Process A runs) + 3 * (number of Process B runs) <= 300
Number of Process A runs and number of Process B runs are nonnegative integers
